messages.subject: actionButton with shinydashboard not working
parts:
Does anybody have this problem as well? Minimal example (similar to http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/actionbutton-demo.html):

library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)

ui <- dashboardPage(
  dashboardHeader(),
  dashboardSidebar(),
  dashboardBody(
      numericInput("n", "N:", min = 0, max = 100, value = 50),
      br(),
      actionButton("goButton", "Go!"),
      verbatimTextOutput("nText")
      )
    )

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
    ntext <- eventReactive(input$goButton, {
    input$n
  })
  
  output$nText <- renderText({
    ntext()
  })
})

shinyApp(ui, server)
